definitions.contributor_pair: Within a D2 skeleton, first title and first contributor slot zipped by page occurrence; no identity resolution or external knowledge.
definitions.infobox_field: Article text with a byte-level {{Infobox prefix and newline |key=value fields up to the stated bounds; no template parser is assumed.
definitions.numeric_field: Bounded |key=value lines with at least one decimal-like byte token; relations are only an opportunity, not measured predictability.
definitions.redirect: Case-insensitive byte lines beginning #REDIRECT followed by [[.
definitions.repeated_line_family: UTF-8-agnostic byte lines up to 512 bytes normalized by replacing bounded links, URLs and numeric tokens; counts only repeated normalized forms.
definitions.repeated_paragraph_family: Byte paragraphs split on blank lines, at most 1,024 bytes, with the same link/URL/numeric normalization.
definitions.template_occurrence: Non-nested single-line {{...}} byte spans up to 512 bytes; nested/multiline templates are excluded.
definitions.title_reuse: D2 title column values repeated within the same page-skeleton column.
definitions.url_citation: HTTP(S) domain bytes and bounded <ref>...</ref> or self-closing ref spans.
definitions.wikitable: Lines beginning {| and |- or | by simple byte regex; nested/template table syntax is not interpreted.
definitions.xml_wikitext_topology: D2 page skeleton/slot layout plus body marker presence; it does not parse or normalize XML/wikitext.

limitations: Approximate byte detectors; no XML/wikitext parser or reserialization.
No compressed asset, entropy estimate, or comparability claim.
Coverage categories overlap and must not be summed.
No numeric, relation, title, contributor or text coding was performed.

proposed_mechanisms.category_interlang: Category/language-prefix terminal stream with complete raw link escapes.
proposed_mechanisms.contributor_pair: Per-skeleton title/contributor relation model only after matching raw field columns and explicit exception stream.
proposed_mechanisms.infobox_field: Validated infobox field columns keyed by exact field-name bytes; preserve unknown/nested syntax literally.
proposed_mechanisms.numeric_field: Per-field canonical-number validation followed by causal delta/error stream and raw spelling escapes.
proposed_mechanisms.redirect: Redirect target field stream with a literal fallback for noncanonical syntax.
proposed_mechanisms.repeated_line_family: Bounded line-family dictionary plus exact member/escape stream, selected only after physical framing comparison.
proposed_mechanisms.repeated_paragraph_family: Bounded paragraph skeleton/reference stream with raw exceptions and explicit boundaries.
proposed_mechanisms.template_occurrence: Template terminal/field layout stream with raw nested or multiline exceptions.
proposed_mechanisms.title_reuse: D2 short title column composition/order coding with a matched arithmetic control and charged counts.
proposed_mechanisms.url_citation: Domain/citation layout columns plus raw URL/citation escape payloads.
proposed_mechanisms.wikitable: Validated row/cell column streams with raw fallback for nested or malformed tables.
proposed_mechanisms.xml_wikitext_topology: D2 skeleton-relative field columns; then condition value coder on skeleton/slot class.
